name: Mysteriarch
body:
Before the gods settled upon spells as their standard boon for their servants, they granted access to the energies of life and the raw substance of creation itself. While this practice has largely been abandoned by the myriad divine powers, it still persists among the members of the akashic pantheon.

Role: More than capable of upholding the honor of their deities in battle, mysteriarchs often prove stalwart and capable combatants. Their true strength lies in their capability to draw upon the power of their deities, whether to increase their own and their allies’ prowess in battle, to vex their foes with divinely granted akashic manifestations, or to lend healing to companions in need.

As their powers are influenced by their faith, all mysteriarchs must focus their worship upon a divine source. While the vast majority of mysteriarchs revere a deity from the akashic pantheon, or the akasha aligned Great Moth’s pantheon, some follow deities of magic or knowledge, a small number dedicate themselves to a divine concept worthy of devotion—such as battle, death, justice, or knowledge— drawing on its presence within the akashic record, free of a deific abstraction. (Work with your GM if you prefer this path to selecting a specific deity.)

Alignment: A mysteriarch’s alignment must be within one step of their deity’s, along either the law/chaos axis or the good/evil axis.

Hit Die: d8.

Starting Wealth: 4d6 x 10 gp (average 140 gp).

Class Skills: The mysteriarch’s class skills are Appraise (Int), Bluff (Cha), Craft (Int), Diplomacy (Cha), Heal (Wis), Knowledge (arcana) (Int), Knowledge (history) (Int), Knowledge (nobility) (Int), Knowledge (planes) (Int), Knowledge (religion) (Int), Linguistics (Int), Profession (Wis), and Sense Motive (Wis).

Skill Points at each Level: 2 + Int modifier.

Note: “+1” represents the dominion veil slot.

Bonus Languages

A mysteriarch’s bonus language options include Celestial, Abyssal, and Infernal (the languages of good, chaotic evil, and lawful evil outsiders, respectively). These choices are in addition to the bonus languages available to the character because of their race.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

Mysteriarchs are proficient with all simple weapons, light armor, medium armor, and shields (except tower shields). They are also proficient with the favored weapon of their deity. If their deity’s favored weapon is unarmed strike, they gain Improved Unarmed Strike as a bonus feat.

Aura (Ex)

A mysteriarch of a chaotic, evil, good, or lawful deity has a particularly powerful aura corresponding to the deity’s alignment (see the detect evil spell for details).

Veilweaving

A mysteriarch learns to shape the magical power known as akasha into powerful veils, which are drawn from the radiant veil list. They know and can shape any veil from this list. The mysteriarch uses their Wisdom as their veilweaving modifier, and has a veilweaver level equal to their class level. The DC for a saving throw against a veil’s abilities is 10 + the number of points of essence invested in the veil + the mysteriarch’s veilweaving modifier. The mysteriarch can only shape a certain number of veils per day. They can shape 1 veil at 1st level, and gain the ability to shape 1 additional veil each day at 2nd, 5th, 8th, 11th, 14th, 17th, and 20th level.

A mysteriarch can’t shape veils of an alignment opposed to their own or their deity’s (if they have one).

Veils associated with particular alignments are indicated by the chaos/chaotic, evil, good, neutral, and law/lawful descriptors in their descriptions.
